videos.script: Thursday's visitor was not new to everybody. {{known}} Three other firms had seen the same address the week before, and one of them wrote it down and shared it. That is threat intelligence: what other people learned, in a form you can use. {{intel}} This lesson sorts it into four kinds, by who reads it. Then it asks how much to believe a source, and what the colours on a shared report mean. {{trust}} You will read a report in STIX, the standard format, and match it against the week. {{match}} One address matches, one adds weight, and one has expired. The last section turns the question around: what can anybody learn about your own company, from the outside? {{osint}}
